cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: It Was Foreshadowed
cards.instruction: Turn the failure into a planned turning point by returning to earlier details that now appear to predict it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coats on. I said that loose peg would matter; this is the outdoor part of our weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were supposed to fix it before the tent fell.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry the canvas. You lead us to the car; we were due a walk anyway.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's raining, and the car's a mile away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my coat as well. That loose peg was our first sign this would be a walking weekend.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 takes charge and calls peg a warning of the intended outdoor phase; A3 carries canvas and A5 offers coat to keep B following the reinterpreted trip.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 failed repair causes A3 shared return-to-car work; B4 rain and distance cause A5 warmth plus a walking-weekend claim tied to the peg.

relationship.evidence: B4 practical discomfort prompts actual support, not a rhetorical question to elicit the lesson.

heightening.evidence: A5 enlarges the supposedly anticipated outdoor phase into the purpose of the whole weekend in response to the long exposed walk.

specificity.evidence: A1 peg, B2 fallen tent, A3 car and B4 one-mile rain supply the relevant physical situation.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 coat offer belongs to B need; the remaining peg claim is A attempt to secure belief in the plan.
